item.title: Aggregation Functions
item.description: In Clojask, you can aggregate on the whole dataframe, or on the group-by dataframe. We call the first case "simple aggregation" and the second "group-by aggregation". Some given functions for simple aggregation are defined in namespace clojask.api.aggregate, and the given functions for group-by aggregation are defined in namespace clojask.api.gb-aggregate.Below is the full list of given functions for the two types.
